explanation:
Choice C is correct. In round $1$, $320$ players compete in $160$ matches, so $160$ players are eliminated. In round $2$, the remaining $160$ players compete in $80$ matches, eliminating $80$ players. Each subsequent round eliminates half as many players as the previous round: round $1$: $160$, round $2$: $80$, round $3$: $40$, round $4$: $20$, round $5$: $10$. This is an exponential decay pattern where each term is half the previous term. The general form is $n = 160\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{k-1}$, which can be rewritten as $n = 160 \cdot 2 \cdot \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{k} = 320\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{k}$. Therefore, the equation $n = 320\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{k}$ correctly gives the number of players eliminated at the end of round $k$.
